title: SELFDEFEND: LLMs Can Defend Themselves against Jailbreaking in a Practical Manner
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical security framework called SELFDEFEND designed to protect LLMs from jailbreaking attacks. While it discusses safety alignment and harmful content (which have ethical dimensions), its primary research goal and evaluation metrics (Attack Success Rate and latency) are centered on security and defense mechanisms rather than the evaluation of moral reasoning, ethics, or religious content.
